entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. What specifically is the issue with the band?
Look, I **don't have time** to troubleshoot. The heart rate is all over the place. The thing is **garbage** and I want a **refund**.
I understand your frustration. I just need to ask a few questions to see if it's a technical fault or perhaps a preference issue so I can find the right solution for you.
There's no solution needed. I **just want my money** back. It doesn't work. Can you process a return, yes or no?
Okay, one moment please. Let me pull up your account and our policy information. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Let me just check the return eligibility... Yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window.
Great. So you can process it?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
